title: OOOSplat: free Polycam alternative
caption:
Polycam charges $150/year. OOOSplat turns your videos into 3D scenes on your own computer for free 🧊

✅ One click from a video or photos to a 3D scene
✅ Supports 360° video
✅ Runs fully on your machine, nothing is uploaded
✅ No subscription, no cloud, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Windows is the main build. The Mac (Apple Silicon only) and Linux (Ubuntu 24.04) versions are Alpha, and it runs best with a dedicated graphics card

Comment "SCAN" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
